pages.title: jet space suit
pages.text: Compared with alloy spacesuits, jet spacesuits have higher armor value, extra oxygen reserves, and - it has a jetpack that allows you to fly in the air. A jet spacesuit is expensive, but its ability to fly at high speeds will definitely make it worth it.

Pressing different buttons triggers different flight modes: press $( k:jump ) to stroll in steady mode, or press $( k:jump ) and $( k:sprint ) simultaneously to sprint in boost mode. Stabilized mode will slowly lift you up from where you were, while Boosted mode has the effect of being propelled by a firework rocket while equipped with elytra. The jet suit requires energy to operate. Hold it and right-click on the energy station to recharge it.
